native_adaptations: Question uses owned async callbacks and JSON scalar/structured validator results, optional parameter variants, injected AsyncBufRead, UTF-8 full lines and Duration timeouts; real terminal lease restores modes. Choice, tables, progress and other inherited APIs remain separately open.

Choice answers use the established JSON/text model and canonical ordered keys. Display labels are explicit text snapshots through ChoiceLabel, not PHP object identities. Templates accept one answer argument with positions/flags/width/precision and scalar conversion; invalid UTF-8 becomes a sourced InvalidEncoding error. Explicit ConsoleError::from_runtime_source marks console runtime failures while ordinary sources remain retryable. Raw data and href targets retain original bytes.

Named Table styles now resolve through application-owned definitions: table default, table_named, table_with_named_columns, Table named setters, shared references and explicit clones are verified by console_table_definitions. Typed convenience variants remain available; complex cells/sections remain separate.

Table convenience methods accept Into<TableRow> for real heterogeneous separator/data rows. Actual Artisan and HTTP consumers plus 420 fixed-source layouts verify separator ordering and orientation; inherited separator cell options and spans are not counted complete.

TableCellStyle all five methods, TableCell with_style/get_style and nested default separators are real public renderer consumers. Preprocessing and column-major width callbacks, per-physical-line format capture and live separators follow fixed source. Spans and section redraw remain open.

TableCell/Separator full typed options, inherited getters and rowspan/colspan now have source oracles and actual HTTP/Artisan consumers. ConsoleSectionOutput/append_row redraw and other inherited component interfaces remain open.

Output::section and actual Table::append_row are verified. ConsoleSectionOutput exposes output options, formatter/verbosity controls, height/clear/overwrite/content; safe handles replace shared mutable stream references. OutputStyle::section(message) remains a separate heading SDK gap. Section-bound progress and interactive input are not claimed by this batch.

OutputStyle now stores the selected OutputReference; get_output returns a mutable borrow of it. AsOutput constructors borrow plain Output, current references and sections without moving an existing &mut Output. Read-only Deref preserves capture-buffer reads, no DerefMut allows bypassing selection. Explicit concrete raw-output helper annotations may use &mut impl AsOutput; Nested style/counter forwarding is verified by nested-style-contracts.json; arbitrary OutputInterface sinks remain separately open.

The terminal completion state machine tracks entered text, accepted full choice and active suggestions separately. First backspace removes the visible suggestion; later backspace removes input, and completion takes precedence over multiline reading. Existing key-event lease/polling, input normalization, callbacks, validators and formatter are reused; no second dispatcher or dependency is introduced.
StyleInterface在console::style和console根导出同一真实Trait，18方法经过泛型／dyn连续消费者；四个异步Trait入口使用ConsoleFuture装箱以保持对象安全，具体类型inherent async不增加该层。Trait要求Send，不要求NewLineAware。
ConsoleStyle是独立基础类型，复用现有引擎但不Deref/实现NewLineAware；selected output增加私有stderr选择及连续aware起点缓存，普通计数维持O(1)。Base iterable逐项写出，derived保留换行统计预收集，均有真实门闩和源对照。
